No high-impact breaking changes are present in this diff. The five changed files are all TypeScript source files, and the diffs show only:

## LOW IMPACT

### Component: `ha-entity-id-icon` (new)

**What changed:** A new custom element `ha-entity-id-icon` was added (`src/components/ha-entity-id-icon.ts`). It renders either a `ha-state-icon` (when a live entity state is available) or a `ha-domain-icon` (fallback). It consumes entity state via context and accepts `entityId` and `state-title` attributes.

**What ha-lcars rule it affects:** None currently. The ha-lcars theme does not target `ha-entity-id-icon` anywhere in `preamble.yaml` or `defaults.yaml`.

**Suggested fix:** No fix needed. If this component appears in contexts that ha-lcars already styles (e.g., inside entity rows or tile cards), the icon color will inherit from the existing `--state-icon-color` variable that ha-lcars sets globally and per-card-type. Optionally, the theme could add a targeted rule such as:

```css
ha-entity-id-icon {
  color: var(--state-icon-color);
}
```

…but this is not required at this time.
